name: LibraryValidate
description: Validate a Library resource against the SQLQuery and SQLView profile rules. Returns an OperationOutcome whose issues describe any conformance problems found.

parameter.name: resource
parameter.documentation: The Library resource to validate against the SQLQuery/SQLView profile rules.

parameter.name: return
parameter.documentation: An OperationOutcome whose issues describe any conformance problems found. An empty issue list indicates a conformant Library.
